assets.label: EXHIBIT 6-26
assets.caption: EXHIBIT 6-26 Considerations for Vendor- or Contractor-Supplied Supporting Columns. Two side-by-side hand-drawn elevation views (A and B) of an exchanger supported on columns: View A 'SUPPORTING COLUMN BY CONTRACTOR' showing platform steel and pipe support carried by contractor-supplied columns to grade; View B 'SUPPORTING COLUMN BY VENDOR' showing supporting columns down to grade integrated into the vendor scope.
